mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(B.ITEM_REC_DTM, 'hh:mi') AS time, C.NR_ITEM_NM AS item, B.REC_CNTE AS value FROM ODS.S_MRNNRVAD A INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRVAE B ON A.CLCO_REC_ITEM_ID = B.CLCO_REC_ITEM_ID INNER JOIN ODS.S_MRNNRIAM C ON A.NR_ITEM_ID = C.NR_ITEM_ID WHERE A.PT_NO = #{ptNo} AND A.UITM_DT::DATE = #{writingDate}::DATE AND A.PACT_TP_CD = #{pactTpCd} ORDER BY C.SORT_SEQ
